tool.title: Índice BODE
tool.desc: Calcule o índice BODE (IMC, obstrução, dispneia e exercício) para estimar o risco de morte na DPOC, melhor preditor que o VEF1 isolado.
tool.lead: Escore de 0 a 10 que combina IMC, VEF₁, dispneia (mMRC) e distância no teste de caminhada de 6 minutos para estimar o risco de morte em pacientes com DPOC.
fields: Distância no teste de caminhada de 6 minutos

opts.1: 1: ao andar rápido ou subir ladeira
opts.2: 2: anda mais devagar que pessoas da mesma idade ou para ao andar no plano
opts.3: 3: para após ~100 m ou poucos minutos no plano
opts.4: 4: não sai de casa ou tem dispneia ao se vestir

sources: Celli BR et al. The body-mass index, airflow obstruction, dyspnea, and exercise capacity index in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. N Engl J Med, 2004.

independentArithmeticTest.scope: 1,920 retained source-point scenarios: exact raw.score at original Table2 integer FEV1/walk edges, all selected mMRC codes and BMI below/equal/above21. No continuous extension across integer-labelled gaps, quartile, mortality or prognosis conformance.

sources.access: Publisher full-text direct request403; publisher indexed abstract available. No full publisher reading claimed.
Original eight-page NEJM article reprint accessible as PDF via www.taiss.com. Non-www mirror timed out twice; the www path returned original publisher pages.
sources.readScope: Extracted PDF Table2, Methods p1006–1007, validation/summing paragraph p1007, Table3 quartile footnote p1008, abstract p1005. Two screenshot calls returned no inspectable image; visual screenshot verification is not claimed.

sources.scope: Independent point assignments and total at every displayed original integer band edge, all five mMRC codes and BMI below/equal/above21, including adjacent binary64 values. No mortality probabilities, survival calibration, full physiological test protocol or continuous extension across integer-labelled FEV1/walk gaps is certified.
sources.limitations: Original cohort comprised clinically stable treated COPD outpatients; post-bronchodilator FEV1 and measured6-minute walk are required source variables. Numerical scoring does not establish COPD diagnosis, suitability for exercise testing, individual prognosis or clinical approval. Updated BODE/alternative exercise models are distinct. The original integer table does not explicitly adjudicate decimal values between35/36,49/50,64/65 or149/150,249/250,349/350; these are excluded from independent point-conformance assertions.
sources.fullOriginalRead: Original publisher-page reprint selected sections extracted; not an entire article or visual-table-reading claim

independentPeer.scope: Independent source tables/own integer expectations and three adapters in Node/VM/Chromium. Clinical/professional-language/rights/full-method approval not performed.

qualifications: Original cohort comprised clinically stable treated COPD outpatients; post-bronchodilator FEV1 and measured6-minute walk are required source variables. Numerical scoring does not establish COPD diagnosis, suitability for exercise testing, individual prognosis or clinical approval. Updated BODE/alternative exercise models are distinct. The original integer table does not explicitly adjudicate decimal values between35/36,49/50,64/65 or149/150,249/250,349/350; these are excluded from independent point-conformance assertions.

Only numeric raw.score is included in the package replay. Main text, raw quartiles/levels, note/verdict/rows, mortality probabilities, diagnostic or therapeutic decisions are not approved by this scoped bank.

The complete bank preserves every stored source scenario and exact input identity; mirror/runtime executions do not multiply case counts. Three adapters were actually checked in Node, isolated VM and isolated Chromium in the linked original receipt, and Node/VM were freshly replayed for preparation.
All 862 historic source fixtures and tolerances remain byte-identical. Four inline records are only a subset of the complete downloadable source bank.

Source citation/edition/rubric and localized-content amendments are separately owned; this evidence candidate must be composed using its JSON field recipes, not by overwriting subsequently amended catalogs. Fresh build/package/browser checks remain required before publication.

tool.limits: O BODE original foi desenvolvido para prognóstico em DPOC utilizando medidas respiratórias e sistêmicas, inclusive caminhada de seis minutos. Não diagnostica DPOC nem fornece automaticamente probabilidade individual por prazo; condições de teste, definições dos itens e elegibilidade devem corresponder à versão.
